data.name: Spontaneous Casting
data.description: An urban druid can channel stored spell energy into domain spells that she has not prepared ahead of time. She can lose a prepared spell in order to cast any domain spell of the same level or lower. This ability replaces the ability to spontaneously cast summon nature's ally spells.
